LightningComponentBundle.masterLabel: Universal Quick File Viewer & Bulk Downloader
LightningComponentBundle.description: Fast visual thumbnail gallery, full-screen lightbox previewer, and 1-click bulk ZIP download for record attachments.

property.name: title
property.label: Component Title
property.description: Header title displayed on the component card.

property.name: cardLayout
property.label: Default Layout
property.description: Choose whether files default to a responsive thumbnail Grid or a compact List.

property.name: defaultFilter
property.label: Default Category Filter
property.description: Default file type category selected on page load.

property.name: enableBulkDownload
property.label: Enable 1-Click Bulk ZIP Download
property.description: Allows users to select multiple files and download them together in a single ZIP archive.

property.name: enableUploader
property.label: Enable Direct File Uploader
property.description: Displays upload buttons and drag-drop zone to attach new files to the record.
